en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestoned street lined with multi‑story buildings featuring shops and awnings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. On the right is a building with a sign reading "CAFÉ D'EUROPA / CAFÉ DE L'EUROPE." The caption at the bottom reads "Trento. Via Lunga." There is handwritten cursive text across the bottom and along the right edge and top margin. The left margin has the photographer's imprint.
